**Finding: MISSING — no vendor insurance clause (severity: low).**

- A full-document search for "insurance" surfaced only the Net Revenue definition (p0012); Sections 14 (Miscellaneous) and 8 (Indemnification) contain no insurance covenant, so the clause fails even the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M).
- Commerce One is squarely within the rule's scope: it places an on-site operations consultant and professional services personnel with Corio (Sections 5.1, 5.2, 5.6) and operates the MarketSite.net Service through which Corio and Customer data flows — i.e., a vendor touching our data and premises, which the playbook treats as walk-away territory when uninsured.
- Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: a new **Section 14.10 Insurance** inserted after the Bankruptcy provision (p0132) at the preferred limits — USD 1M/2M CGL, USD 2M E&O, USD 5M cyber where Corio/Customer data is processed, statutory workers' comp, certificates on request, maintained through the term plus one year. The comment flags the USD 1M E&O / USD 2M cyber fallback and notes that the existing 14.10 renumbers.
